text:
Pro: great for large groups 
Has a brunch menu
Great service
Near Patco train station

Cons: food was just ok

There really isn't much more to mention since the food was just okay for brunch. It was along the lines of something you may have at a casual diner. The server/staff did a great job and we had no problems with our group of 9. They could  accommodate separate checks for people paying with a credit card and that was something we really appreciated. I'd gladly come back if I needed a place for a large group.

I'm not sure what I'm missing, but ordered from Luke's for the first time the other week, got two lobster rolls, and they were just ok. I wouldn't order again. I got it from delivery, maybe they are better in house and don't travel as well.

Ordered delivery from here. Cheesesteak was good. They didn't skimp out on meat and the bread was soft. I would suggest not using styrofoam container to deliver it since it did get it soggy a bit but overall good. Pizza slices were small but flavorful. Tiramisu was really good but kinda small for what you pay. I will be ordering from here again definitely will try a pie. Lastly, they carry Pepsi products not Coke as advertised on menu on Yelp for those that care.

I stopped in this week and Maple Street Patisserie is still
as amazing as ever!

Ditto to everything from my original review, and I need to add that on my most recent visit they had a new creation.   Treats for my sweet fur child! They come beautifully packaged and my sweet girl  loves them!

Thank you MSP for thinking of our furry family members!

Beautiful relaxing outdoor surroundings 
Wonderful fish! 
Great service! 
Worth the dining experience.

This used to have one of the best burgers I've ever tasted, the Bacon Jam Burger. It was so flavorful, a thick, loosely packed patty which, when ordered cooked to medium, always came our perfectly cooked. It was a bit on the pricey side at $13.99, but worth every penny. Everyone I recommended it to was always blown away. Sadly, somebody in management decided they needed to change perfection and make a completely ordinary hamburger that you can get anywhere else. Now it's two thin, fully overcooked patties they call a "smash burger", and it's as blah as you can imagine.  Even the recipe of the bacon jam topping appears to have changed for the worse. The price hasn't changed, just the quality and flavor. I guess they wanted to go with a thin patty that requires no skill to cook, because you just throw it down on the griddle, smash it and cook it till it's dark brown outside, ensuring a dry, gray interior with no flavor. So where I once used to eagerly tell friends about the best place to get a killer burger, and I had to go there at least 2-3 times a month, I now am sad to say goodbye to this eatery. At least there are a couple of other excellent restaurants just down the street that make decent burgers and happen to cost 20-40% less. Money was never the factor when tasting perfection, but when you're just selling the ordinary, it starts to take on meaning. Unlike most restaurants that desperately try to get you to fill out surveys, Three Kings Pub provides no such option, and

This hotel is straight out of a catalog photo shoot. The front desk staff went above and beyond by giving me recommendations of all the great things the hotel had to offer. There is a gym and speakeasy (hidden bar). The drugstore on the first floor serves coffee throughout the day. I lucked out and got an amazing view of the terrace fountain on the Nextdoor building. My coworkers weren't so lucky. One of my complaints are the elevators running very slowly and for two hours they weren't running at all so we all had to go to the service elevator at the back of the hotel. My other complaint was that the room were not consistent in size or amenities even if we all booked with the same group. My room was very small and had a door for the adjoined room. I didn't have a mini fridge and the dresser was just a box from the floor to the ceiling wedged into a small space between the bed and the wall. However, many of my coworkers had larger rooms that had enough space for an arm chair. Their dresser was built into the wall which was sleek and included a mini fridge hidden inside. Their bathroom was also larger than mine. I had to close my bathroom door just to be able to get to the shower door. The room is completely automated to use switches available bedside and by the door. Even the window shades roll up and down with the press of a button. The AC unit was digital and the alarm clock has usb plug ins to quickly charge your devices. The best part was the view from the rooftop bar. The

I checked out pho bowl and was pleasantly surprised. You place your order and sit anywhere you like until your food is served. My kids both had chicken pho. I had shrimp pho and we order shrimp spring rolls. They have a veggie bar and free shrimp chips!!! We loved everything!We also had boba smoothies. My favorite was the taro. My kids had strawberry and mango. They both preferred my taro lol. The owner was pleasant. I will definitely be back to try other items on their menu.

The brunch here was great! It was pricier than most brunch places, but that is what I expected going into the experience since I know this place is really nice. I went with a group of four people on a Sunday afternoon, and the restaurant was packed! I highly recommend making a reservation. 

We ordered the brunch for the table option, which is an awesome combination of food for the table! I would say that it comfortably feeds two-three people. We also ordered an extra entree (the burger) for the table. If we wanted, we probably could have ordered an additional dish. We ordered mimosas for the table too. Overall, i thought the scrambled eggs that came with the table option were really, really good! I also liked their potatoes. The meat was good overall, but nothing spectacular. I'd want to come back and try dinner.

I had a chicken sandwich and loved it. When my mother went inside she said our server was serving drinks and not serving customers. I mean I'm sure with all the pubs around you can find one bartender that will work full time. Other than that loved the food and wished my umbrella didn't try to fly away when it was opened.
Was not impressed.  I ordered the chicken and waffle sandwich and it was terrible.  Too much sugar.

I ordered the Lemmon pepper rainbow trout with mustard greens, baby carrots and a diet Dr Pepper. The fish tasted like a stagnant pond smells. Nothing like rainbow trout! There were five baby carrots which were so over cooked they didn't need chewing. The mustard greens didn't have their own flavor, they tasted like the ham that they were cooked with AND so over cooked they had the texture of canned spinach. Now you would think that they wouldn't be able to mess up a diet DR Pepper but...it was diluted by a few melted ice cubes! 

The store was nice!

Quality pizza.  I had the Southern Belle.  I didn't want to get the large size for the special crust cause I was concerned it would be too much pizza for me.  It was good without the special crust, so it would probably feel like heaven to have the special Rize crust.  You have to specifically ask for it and for the large size only.

Their individual slices looked really good.  I want to go back just to get one, but another time, lol.  Since they are in the suburbs and a local place, I wouldn't expect the pizza to be super fresh by the slice around 7 PM when they will close soon.  If you want super fresh, you need to order one that has to put in the box.

They need to find a way to update their hours as they are only open till 8 PM on Sundays now on their website.  Not sure if it's cause of covid or cause of lack of business between 8-9 PM on a Sunday or if they just understandably don't want to work that much longer.   

Based on looking at other reviews, looks like they should write on the box what the item is.  They seem to have trouble giving the right items to people.  Cause one person didn't receive their sandwich in another review, and in mine, I had to drive 30 seconds back to exchange a wrap with my mac & cheese sticks.    

Really nice people and appropriately laid back.

'==================

11/19/20  lol, I went back and got the Pepperoni and the Monte Cristo, one slice of each.  And they used their Rize crust for the by the slice.  YUM!!

Nam Khao is very good! It tastes just like how my aunties would make it. I have been traveling to Indy at least once a month for work and I had been on the lookout for a good Southeast Asian spot. The staff was very nice over the phone and takeout was easy. I'm definitely heading back to try more!!

Amazing. Get the signature skillet breakfast, every part of the combination was perfectly cooked and prepared. Our waitress literally walked in with us, dropped everything and give us superb service with a smile. That counts a lot.

My favorite Frenchy's location in Clearwater, hands down! They are located right on the beach though a bit of a walk away from the pier. This is my favorite location because it overlooks the shore but also because it seems the quality is better than others. We ordered the peel and eat shrimp which was flavorful and delicious. The folks sitting next to us were dissatisfied with their stuffed avocados (turned out to be brown instead of green...) and staff quickly responded. They also complained about the smell of other people but I didn't really notice anything. I guess that's more of a warning since some people may come eat there after a long day of baking in the sun. Otherwise, I had a great experience here with the food and staff who were on top of it.

Very good spot. Enjoyed the atmosphere, coffee and food. Well made "American Style Omlette". For those who aren't Omlette fans there are two types: traditional French Style that is thin and has two folds that meet up in the middle AND the American Style that is thick and folds over once. The American Style is what most in this area are used to. And is usually the one that I DON'T like. Can be clunky, over cooked, dry. This one at Two Birds was not. It was great and I actually enjoyed it. Only detraction of this place was some of the potatoes in the hash browns were undercooked but oh well, didn't take away from the overall appeal.
The app makes it looks like they're open we went all the way there and they will close down very disappointed

The food is so delicious!  We love Indian food! We found this place a few months ago and we come here 2-3 times per week for the buffet. The flavors are so rich and delicious and there's a good variety to choose from. Has a nice "kick" spicy, but not too hot. Dal is great! Service is great and everyone is kind and helpful!! So happy we found this place!
Attended old Friends birthday party in side room, food by Brother John's. Pork sliders, beans, collard greens, pretty good. Would return for a full meal.

With help from the very friendly staff, I figured out how to order on my first visit.  By my second visit, I was a pro.  Now, with on line ordering and pick up, it's even easier.  The food is really fresh and delicious - especially the blueberry tea and açaí bowls.  My husband has been enjoying brunch and is happy that there are lots of healthy alternatives that are not fried.

My wife called ahead to order dinner for our family for a special occasion.  She called at 4 pm and was told that they were 1.5 hours out on all orders.  She told them that we did not need it until 6 pm, so it would work great.  She shows up at 6 and was told to wait in her car.  So she did.  After 45 minutes she goes back in and they are working on the order...

Of course, we tipped ahead of time.  I tried calling but no one answers the phone.  You can't even leave a message.

I have to add an update after dinner. The hot food was ice cold.  The cold stuff was room temperature.  Such a disappointment.  I have continued to call and no answer.

Next day update:

The owner reached out to me.  He was sincerely apologetic and took some appreciated steps to fix the situation.  The 1-star event still happened but his efforts are worthy of some recovery points.

A very good surprise. Cosi, welcoming, nice light and green deco... all is in line with the spirit of having things respectful of nature and of ourselves. I have the veggie wrap... first time having the wrap made of coconut, you must give it a try ! The smoothies are delicious as well, try the Morning Superstar and the Liger... can't go wrong with that. As far as price goes... decent. Would go back again for sure !

Conceptually this place is great...water front, their own fishing boats, real wood grill yet upon execution stumbles badly (wrong orders, hair in food, wrong check amounts, etc).  I had way higher hopes.  The positives tuna app was great as well as the salmon. Hog snapper and mahi Oscar were boring /bland.

They have an online check in system where you can put your name in for a "call ahead" type seating. We did that and were told to arrive at 10:52 to be seated. We arrived at 10:48 and were told it was another 35 minutes. We explained we checked in online and the hostess was extremely rude. She said the online system didn't matter and we had to wait even longer. They really need to get it together there. 

Update in Response: the wait was 25-35 minutes online and then another 25-35 minutes in person despite using the online system? That just means you weren't honoring the online system at all, so why have it? 

Wait times aside, rude dismissive staff is unacceptable and not due to "holiday weekends."

I know McDonalds isn't a 5 star restaurant but it shouldn't be that hard to get someones order correct. Hoping that service will improve I keep coming back to this McDonalds because its closest to my house but alas I will stop. They never get my order right and half the time I get to the window I have to remind them what I even got. Terrible. Over it.

This place is hit or miss one day the food and drinks are great the next the food is too salty. The staff most of the time are good. I believe too many young people work here. My son loves the ribs but I believe they are too spicy for a regular kid meal.

Everything we tried was excellent - so fresh and light! Most items are suitable for sharing. My favorites were the brussels sprouts salad, the shrimp and fois gras dumplings, the pasta, and the octopus.  Looking forward to going back for their cheese and charcuterie menu. I also appreciate their sanitary and safety measures during the current COVID-19 climate (as of Sep 2020)!
Very very good. Even more overpriced. The Vietnamese coffee is phenomenal. So is the chocolate mousse if you're used to paying $350/oz.

I got takeout from here last night and I was blown away.  Everything was fresh and delicious and the flavors and textures in each dish were just perfect.  I last on the phone recommended #52.  I want to go back again tonight !

1- Housekeeping: bathroom too small and shower with mold.
2- Food: Breakfast is of poor quality and expensive. 
3- Customer Service: front desk, and receptionists at the exercise room are very rude
We love Archie's!  We have been eating and drinking here for over 13 years, ever since we moved to our new home in the North area! Thanks

FINALLY a quality Italian restaurant has replaced the old Gran Sasso spot!  The food here is excellent, especially the unique dinner specials!  If you happen to see the Amaretto Chicken or Amaretto Shrimp on the specials list, you better jump on that!!  They are INCREDIBLE!!

We have become regulars here because no matter what you order, it is always excellent!  There is a great lunch special with cheese raviolis in a rosa sauce that I could eat literally EVERY DAY!  

The customer service is excellent, and the owner, Julio, takes great pride in making everything to perfection.  If they arent too busy he makes rounds and checks in with all the guests - you just dont see that level of care much anymore!

A+ food and service all around!  You cant go wrong stopping in here for a bite - pizza, cheesesteaks, pasta - its all good!!

Great pizza, great sandwiches, very fair pricing. Curbside only right now but the staff is mobile and comes to each car to take your order. Always consistent always hot always fresh.
Are usually come here once a week because the food is enjoyable and yummy

We have been coming to st pete and st pete beach location for years. Tried the original on treasure island tonight and it was such a disappointment. Food was ok but missing some flavor. But it was the service that made us realize there are way too many choices to come back again. No smiles, no thank you. Actually got an eye roll when my husband took 2 pieces of gum from their Halloween bowl. After $100+ bill  for average food and  unfriendly service we won't be back.

Great brunch spot near me. The service was top notch. Our waitress made sure our drinks were always filled. We went in for breakfast on a Saturday and were seated immediately. 

I ordered from the specials which is written on a giant chalkboard wall, can't miss it. I ordered the bagel and lox platter with a side of grits and requested cheddar cheese on top. Note: you do not get a side with the bagel and lox platter, which made it seem a little pricey to me. My platter was $13 (excluding the grits). The grits were very delicious. They gave a little butter on the side and I added a little extra salt and the grits were perfectly creamy and the cheddar cheese made it savory. 

My husband ordered the steak eggs benedict, which consisted of your typical English muffin with hollandaise and egg, but with shaved steak. His side was potatoes. You know the minute the plate is put down that those eggs were cooked to perfection and ready to ooze over the dish when you cut into it! They basically jiggled when you moved the plate. I gotta give the chef skill points for not cracking that egg when putting it on the plate! The dish was delicious just needed a little extra salt for us. 

Overall, a delicious spot, just a little pricey.
Burger was ok not cooked well and i waited at least 25 min. Frrom order until received. Custard was great. Hard to go wrong on frozen custard.
Tiny tiny restaurant with lots of ambiance.  It's off street so it's easy to miss...food is absolutely outstanding.   Best Italian food in the area bar none.

Sadly this was their 'second chance' order.  I ordered GREEN chicken curry (Thai).  I got traditional yellow curry - SO NOT THE SAME.     Green curry comes with eggplant.  Yellow curry had loads of bell pepper.

Mongolian Beef tasted like old beef.
Sweet and sour chicken was OK.  

I should have asked about the chow mein - it is more like lo mein - but that is my fault.  

Thanks,
M

Got take out last night from Trax.  It was absolutely delicious!  Loved the ribs and pulled pork and sides were also amazing.  The cole slaw, green beens, mac & cheese, and home made pickles were all to die for.  We highly recommend..

I've been a frequent visitor of Sahm's restaurants over the years, so I was anxious to try this place.  We have visited the Liter House once, and didn't really love it, so I was hopeful this place would be a good alternative!

I really wish I could give 4.5 stars.  I enjoy their beer, the food was delicious, but I wasn't thrilled with the concept of ordering.  We met friends who were already there, so I don't know anything about the seating process.  The place was packed and I never really noticed anyone waiting around, which was a good sign.  Service is quick so I'm sure that helps table turnovers which is appreciated!

When you order though it starts to get odd.  Menus are already at each table, and they have a variety of cocktails and beers.  When you are ready to order you write down your drinks on little cards and clip them to a bar on your table.  The servers notice this and promptly grab them and then bring out your drinks.  To order your food you go up to the counter and wait in line.  Being the 1st world individual that I am, I hate that!  I don't want to get up for my food haha.  Again, it's a really small problem and is definitely more of a personal preference than a problem with the restaurant.  So I don't want to dock them for it, but without our friends with us, we would have been a bit confused about the whole ordering process.

The food here was good, and I like that they use large, fresh cuts of meat for their banh mi sandwiches.  I tried the dac biet, and although it was good, it was missing cilantro.  

The pastries were an interesting twist on banh bao.  The filing was okay, but I prefer the traditionally made banh bao. 

I wish I had the chance to order a king cake, since that's what I had come for and heard about, but there's always next year!

Great food, great service and reasonably priced. Fantastic BYOB! My husbands favorite is the chicken marsala.  I tried the BBQ chicken pizza with cauliflower crust and it was so good. If you need carb free or gluten free this is the best pizza. Their garlic knots are delicious too.
They have reservations available on open table for 9:45pm but then called me 10 min away from the reservation when I was already on my way. saying their kitchen was closed.
Nice drinks and a refreshlingly quiet place to stop in the midst of the craziness. Make a donation to Villalobos while you're there!
I LOVE ocean world. The staff are so welcoming and genuine. The dynamite is something I  get weekly because it's so good. No complaints

Wow! Fantastic gastro experience was had here! The gnocchi were like little pillows of heaven in each bite. As crowded as it was we had exceptional service and it was very interesting to see the other dishes we couldn't decide on!!! Love it and worth every penny.

First, a shout out to the manager. She is doing a spectacular job at making her guests feel welcomed and valued.

Second, I'd like to say that my lunch was pretty decent. The Buffalo chicken sandwich was absolutely huge... And it was also pretty good. The Caesar salad was nothing too spectacular - But it was fine. This place is a part of a small chain restaurant and is a decent place for  a meal or a beer.

Corporate PF Chang's posted a "please contact us.." post to make it seem that they care. I went to the link they provided and gave them my contact information- no response. Apparently they don't care, which I believe means they won't address the problems at this location. I personally won't be returning to this location- good luck if you decide to visit.

Horrible!   Tasted like crock pot ribs.   They sell their sauce by the gallon, and im pretty sure there was at least that much on my order.   Remember the slaw from KFC in the 70's?  King still serves that stuff, and mine was frozen.  May have been from the 70's!

Love the concept of casual but quality food. They have your pizza ready in less than 30 minutes, and you can eat outside if you want

I always go for the "build your own pizza". The thin crust is so good, as well as the tomato sauce on the margarita pizza. Also love the nutella pizza with gelato on top, is very tasty and you can taste real Nutella on the pizza. If you want to try something different, they always have the "pizza of the month" ready to exceed your expectations.

They also sell salads, which is good because they have healthy options in case you can't eat a pizza. The dressings are amazing too.

Went last night and had really bad service and food was just okay. Sad to say but they really need to beef it up get some cooking tips from R&O's their fried seafood is so good.  The drinks were good but food just okay! It's          a shame because they have a great location overlooking water. The manager came to our table since we waited 30 min for drinks I could tell he felt bad. I hope they can improve with service and food. Best of luck to ya hoping it gets better.
This place is okay. Po boy sandwiches are dry .. bread is hard and the combo little  salty . The give you a dry hard piece of bread to go with combo. Service is friendly

I had the roasted vegetable omelet. Very very good - super fresh veggies, lots of cheese. The grits were also incredible. They do bottomless mimosas/bloody Mary's. If you order bottomless, you can switch between - you don't have to choose one type of drink for the whole meal.

Visited Hopcat on Saturday night.  We put our name in for 5 people at 7:00 and we're told 30-45 minutes, so 3 of us went to the bar and ordered drinks, all us carded, 2 of us are 55, another is 60, and the youngest 22 and 24.  We got our drinks and chatted for 20 minutes or so and then we moved to another space at the bar so all five could sit. As we finished our first drinks we asked about refills and carded again. We showed ID's again received our drinks and 10 minutes later our table was ready. We settled up and moved to our table with each of us bringing our drinks.  Our waiter, Eli, came to the table and said "I guess I'm only serving food tonight", seemed odd and not friendly. I ordered another beer and he wanted to see my ID again, I jokingly said really and he said yes, not joking. He barely looked at it and I asked "what year was I born" he gave me a look and walked away. When the other 55 and 60 year olds ordered a drink he again asked for ID and one said what if I don't show he said he didn't care and walked away, not taking the drink order. Eli had an attitude all night, not sure why he is in front of customers if he is going to be an ass. We asked for our checks and when he brought them he said one was incorrect and he would come back and fix it. When he came back to collect payment I told which items were incorrect and snapped at me and said "I know I'll fix it", not sure why the attitude again. The one star is only a reflection of Eli and his poor attitude and

Let me start by saying-- it's not that the food was bad... it just really wasn't what it was advertised to be. 

Service- There was a large party being sat when we arrived. We stood at the waot to be seated sign for a good 10 minutes before anyone acknowledged we were there to even say it would be a short wait. Eventually I believe a bartender came over and sat us which was above and beyond for him--thank you sir. We came for the Devour Menu. It was decently full for a Covid Saturday. We placed our entire order up front. It was painfully slow. We were probably there 2.5 hours for an app, entrees we ate less than half of before getting boxes, and dessert we boxed up. I understand a reasonable delay but this was a bit beyond that.

Short rib nachos- Holy cow the meat was so tender and flavorful. The Jalapeño crema was delicious. The cold shredded cheese that there was about 5 shreds of and the lack of the delicious beer cheese sauce I'd heard so much about though? That was a bit of a bummer. Regardless, we ate the whole order except for the soggy chips on the bottom.

Double Pepperoni Pizza- My partner said it was fine. 

Legacy maker burger- I was not asked how I wanted it cooked..it came out a little pink so at least it wasn't well done but I would have ordered medium rare. The bottom of my bun was split in half. The hops cheese wasn't melted all the way-just to that sort of "sweaty" stage hard cheeses get. And the "Roasted Pork Belly" is what I would describe as thin bacon.

Some friends and I ordered a charcuterie board at Lab Social, and the second I bit into the bread I swear my eyes must have doubled in size. I couldn't even bring myself to put any of the other things on the board onto it, it was so good. I immediately found out where they'd gotten it from and was stoked to hear that it was a local bakery and I COULD BUY MORE. The first chance I got I went in and bought a bun, and let me tell you, the second tasting did not disappoint in the least. My personal favorite is for sure the pumpkin seed bun. Holy wow, the texture is incredible, the taste is out of this world, and then you bite into a nut and get that nice crunch and another burst of flavor. It's actually ridiculous. The sage garlic loaf is also good but be warned, the garlic is intense. I got some different loaves for appetizers for a party and everyone agreed it was amazing. It's perfect for a cheese board or to eat as a side with a meal. You could probably make sandwiches out of it and it'd be amazing but honestly I don't think I can ever get myself to eat it with anything but maybe a little butter because I don't want anything to distract from the taste. Please go buy this bread. It will change your life. That is all.

I came with 2 friends. Food is really expensive for what it is. My boyfriend's "fried chicken" plate was more like 3 chicken tenders over sautéed greens and was $26. I had some mediocre chicken tacos. My friend's sautéed veggies was tasty but not worth $30. The tomato bisque tasted like heated up marinara sauce. A table near us was playfully yelling back and forth with  waitress at the bar. Not necessarily a bad thing, but just goes to show that this isn't a fancy $30p/plate kind of place lol.

No complaints here! Fresh ingredients and the açaí was thick and not watered down like some places. The location was clean. I wish they would have told me about all the other delicious offerings. They have Kombucha tea on tap and I didn't even notice until when was already leaving. Guess I will have to return.
Beignets are good but nothing to bring me back. You will probably go here as a tourist being that you are trying to navigate your way through this street/area.

Bottom Line: Very, Very Good and very very expensive

My wife and I came here for a date night and managed to get sat on the upper deck with a view!

The nutshell of the night is that we ordered wine, we had appetizers, entrees, and desert.    However the bill was quite a bit larger than are used to for a date night.  The service was good and they deserved the tip that they earned, but it's just too spendy for us to come back.

A DARK AND DUSKY CC'S
The food and coffee are pretty much the same as all CC's however this location has to be the most grim. The drive through is its main attribute. But inside the choice of dark woods and somber colors in the space with few windows, well its glum.

--ate here once in the before times.
now I'm a tough critic when it comes to casual Italian so when I say
this place is halfway solid would probably qualify as solid to most.
I just had the best lunch I've had in a very long time. I ordered the chicken khati rolls, everything was fresh and seasoned perfectly. Highly recommend, good price large portions.

Went to Anthony's again for dinner tonight. The food was prompt, hot and delicious! And the service was great. This was our second visit, Ali and Alex have both been wonderful. Zack, the manager, came to check on us and made sure we were comfortable and enjoying our time- great guy! I think we will be regulars here!!

Went back tonight after a two year absence. It has unfortunately declined from a great experience to marginal. Mussels tasted fishy and frozen as did the crab cake (claw, not lump) Pate was OK, but the bread  served with it was stale. Oysters were cut in half on each shell under a disguise of cheese and bacon. French bread, garlic butter, service and the interior courtyard atmosphere are still great, but I'm reluctantly moving it to the tourist restaurant category. So many better choices.

Absolutely delicious. My order through yelp didn't go through right away but when I walked in they made it right away, I waited less than 2 minutes. Great service amazing food. Was going to take a picture but was to rerouted ttyl dig in.
Great service amazing pizza, calzones, and wings.  Good local beer choices as well.  I have not gotten anything bad here.
Solid spot, but I tend to go with the local option over the chain. It is a solid burger spot with fries and shakes!

the first thing we have to say about this place is that they know their flavor! everything we got here, including cocktails, was jam packed with interesting combinations of intense flavor. 

we got the "i want my umami" and "chiltepin cobbler" cocktails which were so interesting! the umami drink certainly was full of umami, and was the most unique take on a michelada i've ever had. the chiltepin was spicy and fresh and really delicious. 

to eat, we had jackfruit bao buns which were so perfectly prepared it felt like eating a cloud! the jackfruit was spicy and flavorful, and the bao bun cut the spice and gave the perfect balance of texture and flavor. the roll we got was the tataki maki, which was so good and fresh right down to the microgreens on top!

i would absolutely recommend coming here, and can't wait to come  back and try more of their menu!

First I want to say that I have never had such sweet waitresses. Our main waitress, Adrianna, was a doll. You'd never know the place was busy as she seemed so calm and relaxed and seemed like she was interested in the answers to her questions. It seems as if there is plenty of help as other wait staff delivered food or asked if we needed anything. Mostly young people waiting and they were extremely capable.

The place in nice and clean, well air conditioned, and has a lovely outside seating area. Bathrooms were clean as well. 

My husband had a Cuban. It had honey mustard so it was a little different, French fries and coke slaw were good. I had a caramel waffle with bacon, walnuts, cinnamon and vanilla sweetened mascarpone cheese. When Adrianna asked me how it was I said delicious but it seemed like it needed more mascarpone, or whipped cream. It would be amazing if it was served with vanilla ice cream but it would be way too filling.   She brought me a small serving of whipped cream. Deliciously perfect and so sweet of her!

The menu is filled with unique breakfast items and the coffee was good too! It's next to the Newtown Bookstore - a good place to browse.

Checked this place out for lunch. Loved the decor and outdoor seating!

We ordered the chips and queso to share. The chips were very fresh. The queso was very flavorful. 

I ordered the Ensalada De Taco with chicken instead of the spicy ground beef. It comes with cotija cheese, pico de gallo, shredded lettuce, avocado ranch dressing, sour cream, and guacamole in a crispy flour tortilla. I really enjoyed this. There was so much flavor, the lettuce was fresh and crisp, and I really loved avocado ranch dressing and guacamole! The only thing I would change would be the chicken. I prefer grilled chicken vs shredded chicken.

I won't lie, I've only been here once so my opinion might be a little limited, but I have nothing but good things to say about this place so far. Tiny place. Almost no seating. Quaint, intimate, and no bull shit. Minimal employees or fluff. The workers know the menu and seem to love each and every person that walks through the door. Dine in or take home, and a cute patio. You can bring your own wine, which is a huge plus going forward (I wish would have known first). There is a set menu, but has a huge specials menu to choose from. I ordered from that and got the rockfish over linguini with this incredible, rich creamy sauce. Came with garlic bread and they offered more when I finished. Probably best they stopped after that because I would NOT have stopped eating if I had the choice. They also do "bring your own pan" lasagna you can take home, which I thought was neat. I will definitely be returning. Next time with a 9x13 and a bottle of red =]

Absolutely the worst Ever!  I wouldn't even give it one star but this is the only way I can leave this review .  We walked in ordered our dinner waited for it.   The order only took 10 min went straight home ..We were so disapointed the Gov. Chicken was seperated from the batter and soggy and the fried rice must have been 3 days old ..The spare ribs a large order for $14.95 had no meat and were burnt!! 
Wontons weren't even cooked 
We have been going here for 30 years and have never been disapointed 
I called to inquire if there was a new chef.. Spoke to a young man who was not sympathetic at all and extremy arrogant!

The food was delicious. Just such small portions for the $$. Definitely come if you aren't too hungry, or you may need to order several different entrees. With that said, the food was delicious. I had the burrata salad with shrimp added ($16) and my husband had the bahn mi with a side of broth ($11.50). They also had a variety of cafe drinks, alcoholic beverages and desserts. The atmosphere is trendy with a courtyard experience if you sit outdoors.

This place smelled so good driving past that we decided to stop in. We were enticed by the free fry offer when you download the app and it ended there. 

The unfriendly cashier helped me to better understand what I was ordering, never smoking while 2 other people just stood around watching in the front counter area. 

I placed my order, went to he bathroom, which was really dirty. Toilet paper roll on the floor when there was a full one in the dispenser.  Ugh 

Sanitation habits of employees HAS TO BE THE WORST!  The man in the kitchen making fries is PICKING HIS TEETH and touching the fry baskets. No- he didn't wash his hands. I made eye contact but that didn't dissuade him. 

Another guy at the front counter was rubbing his hands on his shirt (chest) and then proceeded to scoop ice cream.  
When I received my order, it was made wrong. And the free fries were cold. 
Stay away unless you want a side of ptomaine poisoning to go !

2nd time updating my review and YAS! Korea House really stepped up!

I had bibimbab lunch special today and I cannot complain at all. Side dishes were amazing and something new I noticed is that now they give you a bowl of miso soup with your bibimbab. I like my egg fried hard and they did accommodate. They were pretty packed for lunch so I was glad to see that this restaurant is doing well during this unprecedented time. 

One thing I want to tell the management of the restaurant: PLEASE have more than just one server at a time! I felt so sorry for the server as he was the only one who was taking care of customers, checks, phone and pretty much everything. I was not mad that it took a while to get seated and order my food as I saw him flying down the hall taking care of other customers.

This is the worst. I waited 45 minutes for raw fish (sashimi) to get served to me and when it got here it had the after flavor of vienna sausages from a can. I ate one of each from the sashimi appetizer and that was the end. Nothing was worth diving into eating (boxed it for the dog). 
The service is the slowest. Even pick up orders that came in waited at  minimum 15-20 mins while I sat here waiting for my order to be served. 
Servers do not take the time to pause at tables. When answering phone they just say hello rather than announcing the restaurant name after. 
Na me thinks not on this one
I always order the light meal with chicken skewers, it's always consistent just like Starbucks. They are very fast but very busy.

My fiancé and I have been here a couple times since they have opened. He has the free coupons for a year so we come whenever I'm in town from school. Today we decided to come and grab a bite with my sister. It wasn't busy at all when we walked in the store. We went to order and the woman that was at the register was kind of confused as to how to ring in an order. I was asking for the Cheerwine BBQ sauce and she was saying they didn't have any made, which was fine, but she kept walking away from the register to check on things. Anyways, we all finally ordered and we sat and waited for 40 mins for our orders. There was a party of 8 ahead of us so we understood maybe 15-20mins but 40? There was also a woman who ordered before us and she was so upset that she had been waiting so long and asked for a refund. By the time we left, we had been in the store for an hour and hadn't gotten any of our food or even an explanation to why we were waiting so long. My sister noticed that there were only 3 people working: a register, drive thru person and a cook. I would recommend having more people any given day so this doesn't happen to other guests that come through. I got a tender meal with mac and cheese and mashed potatoes. The mac and cheese wasn't the best. If my fiancé didn't have the coupons, I would have been mad that I had wasted my money today and probably asked for a refund too.

Honestly high expectations since I have been to other two locations and was super excited to see the new location opening close to home. Positives...drinks were great, staff were friendly and very cool ambiance inside and out. 

Negatives: Food was very slow, which by itself is whatever...but each app came out individually and the each meal came out individually, from first to last (5of us) must have been 10-15 minutes. I got mine last and the wild boar sliders weren't hot, not cold either. Just didn't understand how it didn't come out earlier as it must have been standing.
Didn't see waiter that often, few times had to rope him in and he  never asked how food or drinks were.

Hopefully just the pains of opening a new location, and everything improves as time goes on.

Stopped by and Ordered wings to go was very happy with the service  I did look at menu before arriving and looked at pictures they have listed. Says 8 pieces of wings with drums and flats attached  and shows a picture of a full wing drums and flat in one piece. I assumed you got 8 full but to my surprise I didn't. Don't be fooled by the picture and wording on the menu.

I have been here a couple times and both times were a good experience. We sat at the bar on our recent visit and the bartenders were attentive and friendly. They have a good beer selection and allowed me to sample the one I ordered before ordering it. I decided to order the wedge salad with pulled pork and it was delicious. The crispy onions on top were the perfect addition. However, the portion was way too much. Not a bad thing but it was a lot of food. This will definitely be a regular spot.

*(Tony reached out to me right away.  I am adding a star right now for exceptional customer service and will add more if they return to their former glory when I visit again.)  I am super sad to write this review.  Edge used to be favorite bar.  It was my favorite because not only did they have good beer, but their food was amazing!  Not just bar food amazing, but amazing, amazing! I would go most Monday nights for trivia, and I looked forward to it each week. Their food is no longer amazing, maybe not even bar food amazing.  I have had bad food the last three times I have been there, and if I return for trivia, I probably won't order food. I don't know if their cooks went to the new location or what, but the new cooks need some training.  The once heavenly soup was grainy.  The garlic on the edge fries was burnt and the fries themselves were lukewarm at best.  The recipes are still solid.  They just need people who can still make them.  I know this is brutal, but they had something special, and maybe the feedback will help. I

I am a sucker for anything new. New flavors of chips, new drink flavors, and new restaurants.

The exception is Dill Pickle flavored Chips. I cant bring myself to try that one. Culvers is the newest fast food place to darken the landscape in Meridian.

They seem to come on the heels of Freddie's offering Frozen Custard like Freddie's does.  If you have not yet had a chance to try frozen custard, you need to do this right now. 

Frozen custard is way better than regular ice cream. Frozen Custard is very creamy and does not seem to cause as much of an issue with my daughters lactose intolerance for some reason.

Today, I decided to give Culvers a shot and get a burger and fries from them.

I started with the fries because I love good fries. Culver's fries are crinkle cut which Im sorry to say is the best thing I can say about them. Crinkle cut fries are the best. Im not sure if its because the crinkles hold salt better, they get crispier or what, but they are my favorite fry.

Here is where the story though is over for their fries. They are tasteless. My guess is that they are straight out of a bag of frozen fries. On my scale of 1-10, I give them a -4.

Now on to the burger. It is a common and ordinary burger cooked on a flat top. My wife and daughter said its pretty similar to Arctic Circle. If you like their burgers, you will probably like these.

The burger has almost no flavor at all. The meat is greasy and...well there is just no much of anything good I can say here. The

I recently had the pleasure of visiting attico this past weekend for small plates and cocktails. I really appreciated the covid precautions and social distancing guidelines being followed. There are cute igloos/tents with heaters and lamps for outdoor patrons. The wait staff was very professional & friendly. The highlight for me was def the drinks. The food was a little underwhelming. 7/10 I would def recommend this place for a cute date night or post dinner stop! Very cozy cute and romantic.

Avoid The Joint St. Pete at all costs.  I have been here many times, and brought lots of new customers in.

We went there and my 86 year old husband ordered fish and chips.  I ordered Shepherd's pie.  My husband only has a few teeth, and the fish was thin, and hard as it was overcooked, with Panko on it.  I asked the server for one piece of lightly cooked fish for him.  She took the whole plate back, and shortly after brought another plate identical to the first one.  She asked if it was okay, and I said it is still cremated.  Hubby ended up having the Shepherd's pie.  It came out really quickly.  He ate over half of his, and I had some of mine left.  I asked for a box. We both put the leftovers in the box.

We were both certified food managers, having own a restaurant in Florida.  4 hours later, when food poisoning can occur, my husband had diarrhea and vomiting so bad, I got my phone to dial 911.  The only reason I didn't was because of covid-19, his age, and he has chronic illnesses.  

I was fine, my food was fine, but his was not.  I have heard stories of what might happen when you send food back.  This guy could have died on me.

I still have the box with the food in it, but again because of covid, I haven't taken it anywhere.

I literally just walked out after our food was brought to the table after seeing the person making our food 1. Not wearing a hair cap and 2. Touching his hair the whole time he was making our food then touching our food.  I just don't understand how Cafe flora allows this behavior especially during a pandemic. I was honestly grossed out. I will not be coming back.

I order here a good bit and typically its good.  Lo mein is great, the crab rangoons not so much.  Very little filling.  The last lo mein I ordered was way too salty, but usually its good.  Not the best in the city but good.
Horrible service. I wish I could give it 0 stars. As we sat down the waitress rushed us to order without giving us a chance to look at the menu. Also terrible attitude!

Great staff and great food. Heaps of outdoor seating makes for a relaxing and fun atmosphere. 
The crawfish have the right amount of heat and strong flavor. 
Char-grilled oysters were a disappointment though. Looked and tasted like the parmasen and garlic was added after the oysters came off the grill. 
This has become our go-to for crawfish this season!
Wish I would've chosen somewhere else for brunch in all honesty. I ordered a BLT and the bread was rock hard. I've had a better BLT from a hospital cafeteria.

Really good Thai food!!!! Ordered for take out  drunken noodles and pad Thai and it was really delicious. Food was fresh and hot with really good portion sizes and staff was really friendly.  Defined recommend if you are looking for good Thai food.
This place has delicious Chicken. And the service from Kenny was excellent. If you're looking for great chicken this is where you should go. also they have great forties of Busch beer.
Don't bother making reservations at this establishment! It serves no purpose... they have NOWHERE for our party of 12 to sit - even though they called 3 times today to confirm our reservation.

This place is much bigger than the Bloomington location. It has a lot of options. You get hotpot, buffet, AND sushi AYCE for only $22.99. Everything looks pretty sanitary, except the meats looked a bit unappetizing as they looked a bit too brown on the edges and because they were out in the open there would be flies nearby. The staff is very friendly. Please note that the waiters/waitresses do NOT receive your tips, the owners take those tips so I would say don't leave a tip at all. I wish they would change this practice.

Service was terrible.  They are understaffed (at least this night they were).  Wife and I left after 20 minutes of waiting for drinks, and waiting.  Floors could be swept as much loose debris all around.  limited menu looked OK, but didn't stick around long enough to get an order in.  Beer list looked good, but I couldn't get to the promised land.

We just had a takeout order and it was perfect! Still fresh and hot. Crispy onion rings ( there were a ton) and they did not drench the hot wings in sauce. They gave us hot wing sauce on the side to dip which was awesome! The burger was made perfect and still warm. Thank you to the server that prepared this for my family tonight, we are thankful.

REBRANDED AGAIN: NOW STACKD on Congress.  Lots of Burgers and Wraps that you customize to your desires either Beef, Crispy or Grilled Chicken or Impossible burger.  Four Wraps or Bowls with similar modifications. 

Today tried the Stackd Snacks ="Totchos" get the play on Tots and Nachos?  Has Tater tots, cheese sauce, pico de gallo, lettus crema and lots of Jalapenos.  This is the bomb snack to try out.  Add it to your other main course. They also have plain tots, fries, onion rings, house salad and FRIED PICKLES.  

They also have custom MILKSHAKES Vanilla, Chocolate Coconut and many mix ins from fruit to candy.

Don't know how long this rebranding will last, but previously PokeZone, then Mo's Burger with Poke and now StackD on Congress.  Same phone and address.

Wow. Wow. Wow. So good. Delicious chicken tenders. I was worried about whether or not I should get medium or mild. And luckily enough they allow you to get one medium and two mild, or any variety of ways! The Mac n cheese was one of the best I've ever had!!!! Definitely has a kick, just spicy enough. Fries were perfectly crisp. Thank you Hattie B's for a great take-out experience.

I've been going here for years and always enjoyed the food and experience there. The people have always been friendly until. Beware of the rude older man who handles the money in the soup line. During my last visit, I got the soup to eat there. After we sat down and started eating, I became nauseous after having a few bites of the soup. I wanted to bring the rest home for when I felt better and could eat it, so I went and asked for a to-go container. The older guy at the counter reluctantly gave one, only after he told me I had better bring my own Tupperware next time with such an attitude and rudeness! Oh, excuse me for not planning ahead of time for being nauseous after eating the food that you served me, and for not wanting to waste the food that I paid for. I was so taken aback at his attitude, all I could bring myself to respond was Uh ok? I don't think I have to explain my life story to him to justify a simple request for some supplies they have and offer?

Looks nice inside and out but food is far from authentic.  Drunken noodle is salty and saucy.  Soft crab shell dish is sweet even though I ordered spicy and it was served with sweet sticky rice which comes with a dessert called mango sticky rice.  No apology from the waiter and he said to use spices from a spice tray to spice up.  My husband and I decide no returning to the restaurant and stick to Nooddi Thai in Glen Mills.

A very nice sushi and Thai spot. We hit a wide variety from the menu. I chose the Brit's Volcano sushi from the specials menu (not 100% certain I buy the "one hour only" line). It was everything a piled sushi should be- heaped with an entire box of krab. Hubby was delighted with his veggie roll which had spinach, carrots and pickled veg in along with the standard cucumber and avocado in it. The seaweed salad was plentiful as was the pad seew- which had a slight kick as requested. The sweet potato sushi was a fun veg option to try. Service was prompt with our waitress offering options for each of us. My only knock was the hot towels. Nice touch but they left a slight smell. Throw some lemon in there, Sushi Spot.

Disappointed. Food was cold, menu seems to have different ingredients compared to west port location. Service was extinct. Margarita orders were wrong. Not only was the music too loud, the employees were practically shouting. Understandably, there was a clear dinner rush. We assumed it would take 45 minutes to come out. Chips and guac came out 30 seconds before our actual meal came out. Seemed to have just been thrown together very last minute without any effort given. Again, I understand each circumstance. Just wish their was a bit more professionalism here. Will take my consumption at WestPort's location.
Lovely Minecraft cake for my son. Never knew about this place till this week. The vanilla cream cake was yum and tastefully done.
Best pina colada I've ever had. You can't see the sunset from the deck but the breeze and food are great

I have been to Pirate's numerous times. It is my favorite place to go before my artist, My Acoustic Heart, leaves for tour. We usually stop here for lunch or dinner, before heading to the Amtrak train station or airport (depends on his travel method).

Each time, I have ordered the Greek Meze plate. A couple of times I have ordered a pizza. And of course, baklava! In my opinion, they have the best baklava in town! And they give you a good portion!

On Saturday February 22nd, 2020, we went just because I was craving some Pirate's! No road trip, haha. For an appetizer, I got my usual Greek Meze! Then, a medium Spinach Garlic Feta pizza, which was about 7 slices. Absolutely delicious! I didn't order any alcohol because I was going to be driving, but they have a great wine list! 
I wanted some baklava, but they were all out. I was recommended to try the ice cream. So I got a scoop of the chocolate. And I was so glad I did! I tried the strawberry too! The ice cream tastes homemade! Real strawberries too!

For buffet style food I have to say I was impressed . They have a lot of staff working to keep items stocked , and clean . There are so many cool food items I have not seen in buffets before that were awesome to try . I will actually
Have to go back again 2 more times so I can try the entire buffet . It's so big that you can only try 20 percent of their items . The sushi was impressive being at a buffet ! The other food items were fresh and tasty . This was my first time going . I will be back to try the dim sum portion of the buffet ! So don't be scared by this neighborhood this place is worth a visit !

I kind of regret coming here because I dont live in STL..the food was incredible. And I will very much miss it. 

I was in a hotel so I ordered to go, very easy to do over the phone. I dont know STL well at all,thankfully this was super easy to get to and park. 

I believe I talked to the owner, whoever it was was very friendly and attentive. 

I ordered pakoras, cheese naan, and chicken Tikka Masala.
Pakoras were light and flavorful, not greasy at all. Held up well, everything did, on the drive back. They were still cripsy, which can be hard when ordering to go but they were great. Came with 2 yummy dipping sauces as well.

The cheese naan was to die for. Plenty of gooey cheese, cooked perfectly, nice and fluffy. Same goes for the rice, fluffy and delicious.

I have never had a CTM that was slightly smokey, this was a treat. They use high quality chicken and I was very impressed with how much chicken I got. A lot of places can skimp on it...opposite here. Plenty of huuuuge chunks of white meat covered in their delicous sauce. 

Fantastic portion sizes of everything for the price, this got me 3 meals. 
Will definitely return if I ever find myself back in STL, until then I'll be dreaming

This is a wonderful place to stop by if your looking for a quick bite to eat, I have been very satisfied with my food every-time I visit. I 100% recommend this deli. There staff is amazing, friendly and kind and willing to tell you how amazing there food is and they are correct .
Absolutely delicious!! The food and baked goods were fabulous as well as the service. Very pleased.

If you're looking for a late night snack with some insanely unique cocktails then this is the spot. With a great location in Central West End, the ambiance of this place is second to none! I love coming here for a nice meal, or for beer and sports, you name it they've got it! The bartenders are all so friendly and have remembered me since the first time I was here. Great bar!

Cucina Zapata is the best food truck on Drexel's campus in West Philly.
I saw that they had their Captain Crunch Tilapia burrito and asked if I could order the Tilapia tacos instead? They said they can make the tacos for $3 each. They put avocados, spicy mayo, salsa, cabbage and lettuce in my tacos. In addition to asking whether you want your food spicy or mild. I usually tell them to add that Sriracha sauce for the extra kick. They do not take phone call orders, It is first come, First serve. Cash Only. Their menu is a mix of Asian Fusion and Mexican. Their other menu options are Chicken Katsu tacos or over rice. If you like short ribs, they have that option too. If you're into something more savory, their Thai curry is also delicious. Lunch  hours can get crowded around 12:00 to 2:00 P.M. The truck is worth the stop, visit and catered for foodies ;P
Quiet, elegant dinner but in a casual cool environment. The steak was cooked perfectly and nothing beats the brussel sprouts for a side!

Came here on a Tuesday night and found a packed house. Waited at the bar with the good ole vibrating disc. After no more than 10 minutes we were seated. 

The Icky IPA is a good beer, not too hoppy but smooth. 

Table had dinner, salmon tacos, Greek shrimp salad and shepherds pie 10 minutes after ordering. Server was very attentive. Food above average to very good. 

Happy crowd, hoops silent on tvs and a lively atmosphere. 

Overall a solid experience.
Great bagels! I ordered an egg and cheese on everything and the bagel was loaded with seeds and garlic. It was delicious. The only issue with this place is that the parking lot is tiny!

We came in to eat this morning with two other couples. I had the German pancake with poached eggs and chicken apple sausages. Oh my the pancake is so good just plain with lemon and powder sugar!! Bf had his Cobb salad and boy it was huge. We chatted with everyone for quite some time. Our waitress was great.

No booze which is fine but can only have what's on the menu. No made to order eggs or anything. Fuck kind of bullshit  nonsense is that. Place used to be great now go anywhere else. Used to wait hours in line now just walk right in. I wonder why. Obvious signs of a decline in food, service and a fucken shit business model and direction.
Amazing takeout and delicious food. The staff is so friendly. Highly recommend!!!
We are visiting from Cincinnati and stumbled upon this place. Portions are very generous and mighty tasty. Ladies who run the place are friendly. I will be back for sure.

It is ABOUT time!! I've lived in Tampa for quite some time now. Always said I will reach this place when the time was right. I think the mix reviews from fellow friends led me astray. Thank God for my wife who planned a brunch for my birthday with our children at this establishment. 

First, unlimited mimosas, you can never go wrong with the word unlimited or mimosas in the same sentence.
Second the decor and the AMAZING views from the outdoor seating or just sitting near a window period. A nice sunny day the view is spectacular. Now the food, it is an open buffet where you get to chose from all kinds of yummy food. There is an oyster station, omelet station, cheese, dessert, shrimp cocktails, sausage, bacon, and anything you can think of. What I loved and notice after awhile they take out the food that may have sit or cooled down and replaces it with fresh food. That I was happy to see usually you see the same food just sitting there all day at other buffets. 

So Brunch here is a must for $50 it is worth the price and your belly will leave happy. 

Now I also had dinner here this time for my wife birthday and can you say YUMMY!!!

NO buffet just a menu filled with delicious options. 
For starters, I ordered the cajun broiled oysters, OMG!! Heavenly. 

For our entreès my wife orders the Black grouper, my children had the grouper nuggets and grilled cheese. I myself enjoyed my Seafood Mixed Grilled which consist of 
HALF LOBSTER TAIL, GROUPER, SALMON, SCALLOP, SHRIMP, HARVEST

I order delivery from 615, and my app malfunction and duplicated my order. I attempted to cancel on the app, but it was trying to charge me to cancel. Before I could contact the app company I had a call from 615 seeing if I had meant to order twice and they kindly canceled for me!

It was a great deal for pizza and wings! We got a large 2 topping pizza (although I think they forgot one of the toppings) and 10 wings for $20.99! If you spent $20 you also could get a free baklava. 

The pizza was great, even though the bacon was forgotten. The wings temperature on the hot were perfect (I think I'll try the flaming hot Cheeto next time). Also, the baklava was AMAZING. 

The food and customer service are great!

Good average diner food
Had the burger - ordered it medium and came well done
Ordered pancakes - good but not great
Ordered hot and iced matcha.. both is like water downed whole milk and no matcha taste .. paid $11 for basically milk.. very disappointed
quality craftsmanship and ingredients but everything is way too sweet

This restaurant left so much to be desired. the wait staff was pleasant but took 10 minutes to come over to us once seated. I understand things are different now but we saw our eventual waitress as well as many others pass us by a couple times before helping us. We ordered a pitcher of the house margarita that was weak and tasted just like limes. When our nacho appetizer came no one had given us plates, napkins, or forks. When that came only two forks came for four people. 
We all ordered the taco salad. A mistake. The nachos we had were amazing. Loaded with toppings and the flavors were amazing. The salad was anything but. The salad came in a bowl the size of a cereal bowl and the chicken on top was a millimeter thick and had no seasoning. I had a bowl of lettuce with a dusting of cheese. The promised cilantro-lime dressing tasted like olive oil. The interesting part was one of my friends' salad had good flavor from the dressing. An obvious inconsistency. The manager took mine off the bill once I complained which was nice. 

During a time when service related issues can be overlooked, I would assume places would want to highlight their food. Rosy's failed to produce a tasty entree. Go to this place because it's a nice location with nice people but maybe stick to the nachos.

We were visiting philly from NY and  wanted to have some delicious fresh seafood. We did a bit of research and found this place. We had the mussels in red sauce, Ravioli in Blush vodka sauce with crab and the Sautéed combo (scallops, shrimp and lump crab in a sauce with spinach) with Mashed potatoes. I don't know what  else to say but INCREDIBLE! I repeat...INCREDIBLE! The mussels were fresh and the sauce was a simple tomato sauce but delicious, especially to dip bread in. The Ravioli was made al dente with a vodka sauce that was so flavorful. It was topped with pieces of lump crab and cherry tomatoes. It's the perfect balance!  The sautéed combo, there are no words. The seafood is all grilled, seasoned very lightly and the spinach is cooked in a simple stock, it's all laid out on a plate. We got mashed potatoes and it was the best decision we made. We ate every single thing on our plates. We didn't eat for the rest of the day bc we ate so much and the food was SO good! We also tried wine, the red and white sangria, all were delicious. Get one! Our waitress was really nice, she gave us suggestions and was patience and attentive enough. We had a nice Saturday afternoon here. Will def be back every time I go back to Philly.

Not the Chipotle I know. I wasn't allowed in without a mask, which is a bummer, but the right of the business. When I asked if the door attendant would take my order he refused and pointed me to online ordering. Until they change their policy, or agree to take orders outside of the building, I won't be back

To clarify now that the owner has replied: I wasn't able to place an online order because I was already there. No delicious food for me.

A few days have followed without updates from the store regarding their policies. No communication from the link I filed at the owners request. Appreciate the original communication, and expected I would receive a reply within 24-48 hours as is typical. It seems this burden is too much for them to bear.

had high hopes for this place, seeing that it's been around since the late 70s and it was the first pizza we ate here since moving to tucson in july. yikes was it bad! i'm no snob, but the pizza wasn't as good as a decent frozen pizza. for 24 bucks we got what amounted to a few lousy slices of pizza, flavorless mozzerella sticks, and 2 cokes, which were, easily, the best part of the meal. just bad all round.

I'm only giving it a 4 because they didn't give us the candy in our freak shakes. They were missing the rock candy in the cotton candy shake and missing the spiral sucker in the A very Happy Un-Birthday Shake. For that price, please make them with everything. Overall, such a great place and every kid's dream restaurant!
The Sicilian pizza is amazing!! I'm upset with myself that it took me so long to go in and give them a try, but they'll always have me a customer from this point further!
Long line but worth the wait! Helpful staff and delicious food. Parking tough but also... worth it

I moved from the east coast to the west coast of Florida. I am still trying to find a place like ichiyami in east Boca Raton. I just spent 32 dollars on fried lobster, glass of house wine and soup. The sushi was average, pictured below. Soup extremely bland, zero seasoning in it. The wine was great for 5 dollars. I guess everything overall was just average to me. I felt it was over priced. Use to paying ten dollars less for top end sushi buffet made to order esp during lunch hours?  I didn't get a high end vibe to pay the high end price. Nothing bad but nothing that had a "wow" impact.

The chicken wings and food here are very good. I admit that. However, the servers here are not very satisfied. For the first time, they forgot what we ordered. We were waiting for the chicken wings for more than one hour. When we asked the server, she totally forgot that.
For the second time, they gave us wings with wrong flavors and it took their 40 minutes to fix the mistake. I can't give this restaurant higher score. I am sorry.
服务令人不满意，鸡翅不错。第一次忘了我们曾点过鸡翅，第二次上错了鸡翅，并让我们又等了四十分钟才拿来正确的。

Food was good but nothing special. Steak was a little under cooked . To much hype was given to this place for what you got. The council oak at the Hark Rock was the same price but the Service and food were much better.
Between the food, great Ice tea, and the view, it was hard to tell what was the best. Great place to watch the sun go down..

Went to Blind Onion for lunch today and loved it. Great food. Awesome atmosphere. Good selection of beers. 
Super nice and welcoming staff.

Came for lunch, left still hungry for lunch. We ordered bowls with chicken, rice, and veggies. We also got coconut shrimp as an appetizer. The shrimp was seriously all breading. The bowls were very small and the rice was undercooked (crunchy). Also, they made us start a tab even though we weren't drinking. It was kind of offensive that they thought we would dip without paying. Wouldn't go back, no reason to.

I am happy to report that Freddy's is now open!  It is located in front of Schnucks and across the street from Steak N Shake.  I stayed away for the first week because of course it was very busy.  I decided to brave it tonight and it was perfect timing.  It wasn't busy and there was no line at the counter with lots of places to sit.  The drive-up was however still very busy.  The girl who took our order was very friendly!  There were a lot of workers running around like bees in a hive, but they all seemed to know what they were doing.  It made for a pleasant atmosphere. It seems like training went well.  You usually expect a few bumps in the road when a new place opens, but everything seemed to be going smooth and easy; at least while I was there.  If you've never had a Freddy's burger, it is very thin and super crispy, crunchy.  The french fries are super thin and crispy crunchy too.  My hubby likes the hotdogs and we both enjoy the custard with a hundred choices of toppings!  Okay, maybe not a hundred, but I'm pretty sure they have your favorite.  I had a hot fudge sundae with M & M's.  It was everything you could wish for.  The custard is smooth and creamy and the hot fudge is thick, with a rich chocolate taste and you can never go wrong with M & M's.  So far so good and I think Freddy's is a wonderful addition to Edwardsville!  I have no doubt they will do well.

I've been eating at Steak n Shake for 30 yrs and today was the worst experience. My daughter and I received the wrong sides, I received the wrong refill, and we had to ask the manager for refills and napkins. Our waitress was more concerned with leaving for an appointment than she was about her customers. She had the audacity to pull up by our car as we were leaving and ask how much we left her, as should would be returning later after her appointment. She's lucky she received anything.

Nowhere near the service at the Pasco location! Our waiter wasn't friendly at all and the place had about 4 tables full, so it wasn't because he was busy. The cheese on the grilled cheese wasn't melted. I will try again though.

Absolutely LOVED the vibe here! We were greeted by a feather dancer when we walked in, and the whole experience there on our was beautiful. We took a high-profile client here. Started with the octopus, escargot, and gulf oysters, and I haven't stopped thinking about them since. I could have eaten 8 orders of the escargot. I had the Duck Confit and OMG I LOVED it! For the three of us, with 3 apps, 3 entrees, and a drink each, we totaled $240 before tip. Definitely a great space for a top-notch client dinner.

Writing in because you guys had the nicest delivery guy I've had in awhile. It was a breath of fresh air to  have such a friendly demeanor during all the chaos in Kensington right now. Food was awesome too

Took my pups to this place and ate outside. They were very nice with my dogs and brought them some water. The food here was great and would highly recommend going here. Eating outside on the back patio area was peaceful.

If you are looking for home cooking type meal with family like atmosphere, then a visit here is for you. Always a great experience here. Service is right on at all times. Friendly atmosphere. Food is delicious and served hot. Older style bar and restaurant with that lunch or dinner atmosphere. Hungry, definitely give it a try.  Menu is meat heavy, but there are plenty of options. Wine, beer, and cocktails available. Good place to enjoy a little time and  conversation with your lunch or dinner friends.
Very good, the chorizo burrito and super burrito were delicious! We went there because of these reviews
Came here wanting a nice, clean lunch. This was AMAZING!! My friends and I all loved it. Best smoothie bowl I have ever had. Highly Recommend!!
The calamari was one of the 2 best i have ever eaten. And the gnocci was delicious. Love the socially distanced outdoor area.

Way under expectations. 45 minutes for bruschetta- another 20 for some overly teriyaki salmon. Poor in every respect except atmosphere. If the food were decent I would be more lax here, but I've had better at bars in the loop.

We used to enjoy the food here but today everything was terrible. I received a different salad than I ordered. The pizza and stuffed mushrooms were cold even though neither was ready when I arrived and apparently just came out of the oven shortly after I arrived. I noticed the cook did not have a mask on. I asked if the cooks were required to wear a mask when cooking and the cashier said they don't wear a mask but do wear gloves. Also while she was waiting for my order to come up she had lowered her mask and only pulled it up when I asked about the cooks wearing masks. We ate a few bites and threw the rest away. Won't be back.
